quest.title: Custom Gift Envelope No. 6
quest.description: Someone seems interested in creating a Gift Envelope...

choices.text: Are you... here for a case?

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: I'm being forced to take a vacation.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: The Maison Gardiennage stipulates that all employees are required to use our vacation time by the end of the year.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: The end-of-year calculations came through, and the Patrol found out I hadn't taken a single day off, so...

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: No. Our officers operate on a rotating schedule, but as the captain of the squad, I'm always on duty.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: I also deal with a lot of emergency cases, so over time, I just... forgot to take vacation.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: I was fine going without any time off this year, but my officers wouldn't hear of it...

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: They started shouting about how "rules are meant to be followed" and "a captain needs to lead by example." Basically, they wouldn't take no for an answer.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: One of the Gestionnaires who works with us mentioned how Liyue is a top vacation destination during the Lantern Rite festival. He pulled out a boat ticket right then and there, so... Here I am.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: And I have to hand it to him — Liyue is a sight to behold this time of year. I just came back from Qiaoying Village, actually. I really loved the dim sum made with tea.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: I bought some to share with the Special Patrol. I was planning to follow local customs and make a few gift envelopes, as well.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: It's just... I'm not very good at this kind of thing. No matter what I do, it always ends up looking weird.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: #Do you know how to make them, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: Is it like that for everyone?
You... don't look like you're here for work?

talks.objective: Complete the Gift Envelope with Chevreuse

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Wow, this turned out great! Hmm... you deserve something in return.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Here, take some of this dim sum as thanks for your help. Receiving this envelope from you really makes this trip worthwhile.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: ...Still, I've been away for some time, now. I wonder if my officers are keeping up with their training.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Well, I guess it's time to start planning a fitness test.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: #Do you know how to make them, {NICKNAME}?
